lead: This board is a crypto bid on the August snapshot: bitcoin up on the month, above its 30-day line, and ether outperforming it. That is not a new ticket. Hold bitcoin. It is still not the same trade as gold. Do not add Solana because it led the month. Account holdings did not load on this run, so there is no position tape here.

Ether ETFs out-drew bitcoin ETFs for the month on this snapshot.
Mild on-chain outflow on this print. Sideline cash, not a drain of the system.
